Interface EDPDataSetRecord

  • All Superinterfaces:
    EDPRecord<EDPResponseCommand>

    public interface EDPDataSetRecord
extends EDPRecord<EDPResponseCommand>
    Representation of a single data set record. Provides metadata and field access using field names.

    male
